title: Creamy Barley with Roasted Pepper
description: Quick pearl barley absorbs roasted pepper and a little cream cheese.

ingredients.name: peeled unsalted roasted red bell pepper, pureed

steps.title: Set the heat
steps.text: Use the lidded HexClad wok on a medium burner.

steps.title: Build flavor
steps.text: Warm {barley} in the dry pan for 1 minute until nutty.

steps.title: Cook gently
steps.text: Add {broth}. Cover and simmer 12–16 minutes until tender, adding a splash of water if needed.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Fold in {roastpep} and {creamcheese} and stir for 2 minutes until glossy.

notes: Make ahead: chill in shallow containers and refrigerate up to 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze up to 1 month; grains and vegetables soften slightly. Fridge reheat: stir with a spoonful of water over low heat until 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw in the fridge and warm by the same method. Dairy swap: use unsalted plant butter or dairy-free cheese as applicable. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 212 kcal, 6.7 g protein, 38.7 g total carbohydrate, 4.0 g fat, 7.6 g fiber, 63 mg sodium.
